usage.text:
The pendulum starts at rest at 60°, placing its centre 0.5 m above its lowest point. The four equal balls start at rest on the level rail, with their centres 0.15 m apart.

The pendulum strikes ball1 at 0.54 s. Impacts then pass from ball1 to ball2 at 0.57 s, to ball3 at 0.62 s, and to ball4 at 0.68 s. Ball4 leaves the rail, enters the box, and settles inside. Later contacts from the following balls move it slightly, but it is at rest by 2.58 s and remains so through 6 s.

The world satisfies the brief. Ball2 and ball3 also enter the box, but the brief does not require them to remain on the rail.
